purpose: Define the exact public-safe write contract for saving PMP Inventory Eyes / Lossless Quality reports into the PMP Lossless Inventory Vault.

name_boundary.vault_github_writer: Writes public-safe lossless/inventory reports into GitHub vault files.
name_boundary.safe_writer: Separate existing PMP code/app writing tool. Do not confuse the two.

write_steps: Verify packet.writer_name is Vault GitHub Writer.
Verify privacy_gate passes exactly: no private Bug Memory, no Apple Notes contents, no tokens, no passwords, no secrets, no private values, localStorage key names only.
If history write is enabled, also write packet.report to packet.target_history.
Return a compact write receipt with current target, optional history target, timestamp, and privacy pass result.
hard_blocks: Any token/password/secret present in packet or report.
Any private Bug Memory record value present in packet or report.
Any Apple Notes private content present in packet or report.
Any private localStorage value present instead of key name only.
allowed_writers: ChatGPT GitHub connector action approved by the user
future private backend controlled by the user
future private authenticated writer controlled by the user
forbidden_writers: public GitHub Pages HTML containing a GitHub token
public JavaScript containing a GitHub token
any writer that stores private Bug Memory or Apple Notes contents in this vault
next_step: When a PMP_LOSSLESS_VAULT_WRITE_PACKET is uploaded or provided, use the ChatGPT GitHub connector as Vault GitHub Writer to update current.json and optionally history.
